description: Simulated learners built from the robustness set. Each answers at least one question per concept. targetConceptId / targetMisconceptionCode = the gap a good follow-up should target. When targetMisconceptionCode is null, asking a misconception probe is counted as a false probe.

scenarios.description: Long answer with a buried 'API is a database' belief (graded correct)
Mixed answer: GET named, but POST believed to retrieve data (graded correct)
Mixed answer: password plus 'HTTPS proves identity' (graded correct)
Hedged: can't remember which term is which (no misconception)
Out-of-catalog: 'authorization only applies to admins' (graded correct)
Out-of-catalog near-miss: 'GET can't have parameters' (graded correct)
Informal writing hiding 'server must be hardware' (graded correct)
Long answer with client/server roles reversed (graded correct)
Long but shallow authentication answer (graded correct, no misconception)
Misconception confirmed by its probe answer; stay on Authentication
